input: Get a quote for loft insulation installation

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: The type of insulation (e.g. roll, blown, spray foam) and whether it covers the whole loft or just part of it drastically changes the quote scope and who to contact.
The property type (house, flat, bungalow) and loft size directly affect the scale of the job and which installers are relevant.
Knowing whether the user wants one quote or multiple competing quotes determines how much outreach effort the plan needs.
A budget ceiling or eligibility for government grants (e.g. ECO4 scheme) could change whether the user pays full price or gets subsidised installation.
Whether the user wants to contact installers online, by phone, or use a comparison/broker service determines the immediate next action.
A preference for a local tradesperson vs. a national company affects which directories or platforms to use.
Knowing the deadline by which the user needs the quote ready determines urgency and how many installers to approach in parallel.

gold.taskTitle: Get a quote for loft insulation installation
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to obtain a price quote for having loft insulation professionally installed in their property.

questions.title: What type of loft insulation are you looking for?
questions.description: Determine the insulation type the user has in mind — e.g. mineral wool rolls, blown loose-fill, or spray foam — as this affects which specialists to approach.

questions.title: What type and size of property needs insulating?
questions.description: Establish whether it is a house, bungalow, or flat, and roughly how large the loft area is, so quotes can be meaningfully compared.

questions.title: How many quotes do you want to collect?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants a single quote or several competing ones, which determines the scale of outreach needed.

questions.title: Do you have a budget in mind, or are you checking grant eligibility?
questions.description: Find out if the user has a spending limit or wants to explore government subsidy schemes like ECO4, which could make installation free or heavily discounted.

questions.title: How do you prefer to contact installers for quotes?
questions.description: Determine whether the user wants to reach out by phone, use an online form, or go through a comparison/broker platform to get quotes.

questions.title: Do you prefer a local tradesperson or a national company?
questions.description: Understand whether the user values a nearby independent installer or is comfortable with a large national provider, as this shapes which directories or services to use.

questions.title: When do you need the quote by?
questions.description: Establish the user's deadline so the plan can set urgency levels and decide how many installers to approach simultaneously.
